senses.gloss: विस्त m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a partic. weight of gold (= 80 Raktikās or a Karṣa of 16 Māṣas, about half an ounce troy), Prāyaśc.
वि-√ स्तन् P. -स्तनति, to groan aloud, sound, Bhaṭṭ.; Jātakam.
वि-स्तर mfn. extensive, long (as a story), Sāh.
वि-स्तर m. (ifc. f(आ). ; cf. वि-स्तार and Pāṇ. iii, 3, 31; Vām. v, 2, 41) spreading, extension, expansion, prolixity, diffuseness, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-स्तर m. a multitude, number, quantity, assemblage, large company, Mn.; R.; VarBṛS. &c.
becoming large or great (met. applied to the heart), Daś.
high degree, intensity, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
(pl.) great wealth or riches, MBh.

वि-स्तर m. detail, particulars, full or detailed description, amplification (also as direction to a narrator = विस्तरेण कार्यम्, ‘give full particulars’; ˚रेण ind. or ˚रात् ind. diffusely, at length, fully, in detail; ˚री-√ कृ, to spread, divulge, expand), MBh.; R. &c.
वि-स्तर m. (ifc.) an extensive treatise, CūlUp.
affectionate solicitation, L.
a layer, bed, couch (= वि-ष्टर), L.
वि-स्तरा f. a partic. Śakti, Hcat.
वि-स्तार m. (ifc. f(आ). ; cf. वि-स्तर) spreading, expansion, extent, width, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
becoming large or great (met. said of the heart), Sāh.
the breadth of a circle i.e. its diameter, Col.
specification, detailed enumeration or description, Yājñ.; Suśr. (एण, diffusely, at length, prob. w.r. for विस्तरेण, R. iii, 4, 4)
the branch of a tree with its new shoots, L.
a shrub, L.
the diameter of a circle, L.
वि-स्तरेण ind., diffusely, at length, fully, in detail
वि-स्तरात् ind., diffusely, at length, fully, in detail
वि-स्तर—तस् ind. diffusely, at length, Kāv.; Pur. &c.
वि-स्तर—ता f. extension, spreading, Ṛtus.
वि-स्तर—भीरु mfn. afraid of diffuseness, Sarvad.
वि-स्तर—शङ्का f. fear of diff˚, Sāh.
वि-स्तर—शस् ind. = -तस्, Mn.; MBh. &c.
वि-˚स्तरकेण (or ˚स्तरतरकेण) ind. very diffusely, at full length, Pat.
वि-˚स्तरकेण (or ˚स्तरतरकेण) ind. very diffusely, at full length, Pat.
वि-˚स्तरणी f. N. of a goddess, MārkP.
वि-˚स्तरणीय mfn. to be spread or extended, capable of being extended or expanded, MW.
वि-˚स्तारण n. (fr. Caus.) outstretching (of the feet), Kāv.
वि-˚स्तारिका f. N. of a Comm. on the Kāvya-prakāśa.
वि-˚स्तारित mfn. (fr. id.) spread, extended, Ragh.
fully stated, amplified, MW.
वि-˚स्तारिन् mfn. extending, large, great, mighty, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur.
वि-˚स्तारिणी f. (in music) a partic. Śruti, Saṃgīt.
वि-स्तीर्ण mfn. strewn or covered or studded with (instr. or comp.), Kāv.; Kathās.
spread out, expanded, broad, large, great, copious, numerous, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
extensive, long (as a tale), MBh.
far-sounding, R.
वि-स्तीर्ण—कर्ण mfn. ‘extending the ears’ and ‘broad-eared’ (applied to an elephant), Bhartṛ.
वि-स्तीर्ण—जानु f. a bandy-legged girl (unfit for marriage), L.
वि-स्तीर्ण—ता f. breadth, diffusion, vastness, largeness, amplitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-स्तीर्ण—त्व n. breadth, diffusion, vastness, largeness, amplitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-स्तीर्ण—भेद m. N. of a Buddha, Lalit.
वि-स्तीर्ण—ललाटा f. ‘having a large forehead’, N. of a Kiṃ-narī, Kāraṇḍ.
वि-स्तीर्ण—वती f. N. of a partic. world, Buddh.
वि-स्तृत mfn. strewn or covered or furnished with (comp.), Rājat.; BhP.
outstretched, expanded, opened wide, MBh.; Kāv.; BhP.
displayed, developed, Bhartṛ.; BhP.
extensive, broad, ample, wide, MBh.; R. &c.
far-sounding, Hariv.
spread, diffused, L.
वि-स्तृतम् ind. fully, at length, Śatr.; BhP.
वि-˚स्तृति f. extent, width, breadth, Āryabh.
the diameter of a circle, Col.
spreading, expansion, W.
